title: process-research-now reports curationAssignmentCount=0 after registering prospects
description:
## Observed

`process-research-now --json` returned `registeredReferenceCount: 18` and `curationAssignmentCount: 0`.

Skill contract (`skills/newsroom-research-workflow/SKILL.md`) says the handoff creates curation assignments for pending prospects.

## Expected

Non-zero curation assignment count, or an explicit documented reason when skipped.

## Evidence

`.papyrus-runs/c46828-e2e/process-research-now.json` on branch `epic/e2e-ingestion`.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Diagnosis: the machinery exists, the caller does not enable it

`catalog.py:335`:

```python
if context.get("createCurationAssignment"):
    records.extend(reference_curation_assignment_records(item, reference["expected"], context))
```

`reference_curation_assignment_records` is defined at `:514` and looks complete. The records are simply never requested, because the research-intake path does not set `createCurationAssignment` in its context. Note the sibling flag `createIngestionRationaleMessage` immediately above behaves the same way — worth checking whether that one is set either, since it is the other half of the same provenance story.

So this is likely a one-flag fix in the intake caller rather than new code. Trace back from `build_reference_catalog_registration_records` (`catalog.py:133`) to `intake_research_packet_proposals` (`assignments_workflow.py:1131`) and see what context is being built.

**Before flipping it, check what already exists.** There are 12 Assignments total and 0 curation ones, but 996 pending references — so this has been off for a long time, not just for the new 18. Confirm that turning it on does not try to create ~996 assignments retroactively on the next intake run, and decide deliberately whether existing pending references should get assignments backfilled or only new ones.

## Why it matters

A curation Assignment is the workflow record that a prospect needs review. Without one, "what is in my queue" cannot be answered from the data model — which is why the ingestion exercise wrote a JSON sidecar instead. It is also the natural home for review state that `references triage-plan` currently has to recompute from scratch each run by listing every Reference, Attachment, Message and Relation unfiltered (`references_commands.py:139-143`), which is fine at 5 accepted references and will not stay fine.

Pair this with `TI-a9cb3a` — together they are the difference between a review queue that lives in the schema and one that lives in a file.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fixed on epic/e2e-ingestion: intake_research_packet_proposals sets createCurationAssignment (and createIngestionRationaleMessage) true by default for the catalog items in that run only. Opt out with --create-curation-assignment false. No retroactive backfill of the ~996 pending queue.
